issuer: the competent interior body by the driver's residence: in the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina the cantonal ministries of the interior, in Republika Srpska its Ministry of the Interior, in Brčko District its public register department
note: Read 2026-10-30. The Law on the Basics of Road Traffic Safety in Bosnia and Herzegovina (Službeni glasnik BiH 6/06) is a state law, 'uniform for the whole territory' (art. 1), so Bosnia and Herzegovina is kept whole though its licences are issued by the entities', cantons' and Brčko District's interior bodies (IDDEEA, the state agency that keeps the register: 'in the Federation the cantonal ministries of the interior, in Republika Srpska the Ministry of the Interior and in Brčko District the Public Register Department, by the driver's residence'). The Parliamentary Assembly's unofficial consolidated text of July 2026 (6/06 with every amendment to 35/26, marked as 'for internal use' and not citable in official use) gives the right to drive category B at 18 (art. 184(2)2) and the licence's term, 10 years from issue or renewal (art. 186(3) and (4)); the same words stood in the original 2006 text (then art. 189), saved from the Sarajevo Canton Ministry of the Interior. The form doesn't hold the law's older-driver terms: three years for a holder over 65, and to 65 (but no less than three years) for one over 55 at issue (art. 186(3) and (6)), nor a shorter term set on medical advice (not under two years). Fee null: each issuing body sets its own and none was read. No identity card is held (identity cards aren't this office's), and no exchange list was read (art. 190 exchanges a foreign licence of a permanent resident without a test, on conditions, not for named countries).
